_doc: Caravan (2v2, 3v3): escort the caravan along the map's track to the other end. Two rounds: red attacks first (from the track's start), then blue (from its end). Attackers alone within radius push it (push_speed px a tick, times push_mult by how many: index = attackers there), both sides stop it, defenders alone roll it back at back_speed, never behind the last checkpoint passed. Checkpoints (shares of the track) add checkpoint_seconds and move the attackers' respawn up to them (respawn_behind px back along the track). At time out a round goes on while an attacker is at the caravan, up to overtime_seconds. The second round stops once decided. Winner: the faster finish, or the longer push. Unlimited lives (respawns on the pads like Team Deathmatch); KOs score nothing. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
